customManagers.description: Keep the independently audited Claude action SHA synchronized with the workflow pin

Action pins the canonical generators emit into adopters' generated callers (#1812). Adopters fence those callers (renovate/generated-callers.json), so the pins move here, in the same grouped PR as this repository's workflow digests, and reach adopters only through regeneration.

packageRules.description: Reopen the generated-caller fence for this repository's hand-written release-*.yml reusable workflows: the preset matches adopters' release callers by path, and these share the release- prefix. Only their step actions reopen, and first, so every narrower disable below and in the organization preset still applies (ADR 0232).
Maintain digest pins in Node workflow/setup surfaces
Hosted runner labels are an organization baseline managed as one policy migration, not Renovate dependency updates.

One PR for all action digests. Every Renovate PR here pays a full AI review pass through ai-review-merge.yml and holds a runner on the shared pool while the gate polls, so PR count is the cost — not diff size. These bump together, fail together, and are never reverted individually.

runner-canary.yml is accepted by exact content digest (scripts/runner-canary-contract.test.py, and verjson-cli-cloud's contracts/workflows/runner-canary.yml with its receipt's uploadArtifactCommit). Its pins move only together with that consumer, never in the grouped digest PR (ADR 0232).

pydantic-core is pydantic's compiled backend and the two are version-coupled upstream; a consumer repo bumping pydantic-core alone (verjson-editor#123) risks an incompatible pairing pydantic's own compatibility table would have caught.
